class.name: OcgGceMaketranslation
class.brief_description: This class implements elementary construction algorithms for a translation in 3D space. The result is a gp_Trsf transformation. A MakeTranslation object provides a framework for: - defining the construction of the transformation, - implementing the construction algorithm, and - consulting the result.
